normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to only carries the transfer recipient into transfer(), which immediately delegates to transferFrom().
Parameter _value only carries the transfer amount into transfer(), subsumed by the public function node.
Parameter _from is used only inside ensure() for whitelist comparisons and the condition() gate.
Parameter _to is only compared against owner inside ensure().
Parameter _value is only forwarded to condition() inside ensure().
Parameter _from indexes balanceOf, allowance and _onSaleNum mutations inside transferFrom().
Parameter _to is the destination key of the balanceOf credit inside transferFrom().

Parameter _spender is only used as the allowance key written by approve().
Parameter _value is only stored into the allowance mapping by approve().
Parameter _value is only compared against _minSale/_maxSale inside condition().
Parameter spender is used only as the balanceOf and canSale key inside approveAndCall().
